# std/ansi

Cursor movement, screen control, and 256-color and 24-bit color escape codes: the
lower-level primitives a full-screen terminal UI needs, next to [`std/color`](color)'s
named 16-color wrappers. Each function returns an escape string; build a frame in one
buffer and write it once to avoid flicker.

```milo
from "std/ansi" import { Ansi }
```

## Example

```milo
var frame = Ansi.clearScreen() + Ansi.cursorTo(1, 1)
frame += Ansi.fg256(208) + "status: ok" + Ansi.reset()
print(frame)
```
